sections.title: Pros
sections.narration: The upsides first: one of the cheaper ways to buy useful nutrition. That matters for real diets, not just theory. Does a lot of jobs at once. Protein, fibre, and meal utility are why legumes stay valuable. Filling for the calories. Legumes usually earn a lot of practical value from satiety.
